items.q: But the first club, the first jazz club -- Dicky Wells (inaudible) opened there.

ctx.x: (Inaudible) we played the BIRDLAND. But the first club, the first jazz club -- Dicky Wells (inaudible) opened there. What was the name? The Ebony Club.
Ebony Club. This was Dicky Wells, the trombonist.
